description: Object passed to `bootstrapApplication()` whose `providers` populate the root environment injector.
Opaque provider bundle returned by `provideX()` functions; only valid in environment injectors.
Wraps providers into `EnvironmentProviders` so you can write your own `provideFeature()` function.
Runs a function in an injection context before bootstrap. Returned Promises/Observables are awaited. Replaces `APP_INITIALIZER`.
Runs synchronously when an environment injector is created. Replaces `ENVIRONMENT_INITIALIZER`.
Creates a child environment injector from a provider list and a parent.
